newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bourse pursues upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bourse pursues upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange rose further on Wednesday with the all-share index closing at 436.61 points, up 0.12 percent over Wednesday's session.
Wafabank, which remains the main engine behind the bourse rise, rose 15 dirhams to close at 560 dirhams.

"According to the market rumours, Wafabank is expected to expand its network by 60 branches throughout the country...It is also expected to increase its capital soon," a Casablanca-based stockbroker said.
Wafabank has a capital of 553.1 million dirhams.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, Morocco's second largest conglomerate, rose one dirham to 560 dirhams.
Societe Cherifienne des Petroles, which will be privatised this year, rose 25 dirhams to close at 525 dirhams.
Mining company Zellidja jumped to 435 dirhams, up 110 dirhams in one session.
Banque Commerciale du Maroc, the market's largest capitalisation, remained unchanged at 694 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 35.9 million dirhams, up from 31.3 million dirhams.
